receipt.equivalence_review: The complete 16-block response contains no Wi-Fi provider; successful wifi and wireless part searches were also empty. Original N2 requires Wi-Fi and explicitly excludes wired UART substitutions. UNSATISFIED_SELECTION/functions.wifi independently replays; no fabricated parts or failed-query-as-absence reasoning.

refusal.reason: The required Wi-Fi module cannot be selected from the pinned closed-world catalog. The complete block search returned 16 AGENT_VERIFIED blocks, none in wireless.wifi and none implementing Wi-Fi; the available UART header and USB-UART bridge provide wired interfaces only. Part searches for wifi and wireless both returned empty results. The mandatory Wi-Fi function forbids substitution by UART or another wired interface, so no eligible catalog block satisfies this requirement.
